text:
leah_fin: Noticing a small but systematic underbilling pattern for Azure reseller discounts this month. The per-line discount cap is being applied after rounding which reduces the effective discount. Seeing this across ~160 lines.

sam.billing: Can you show an example line and expected vs actual?

leah_fin: Example from export: ```invoice_id,sku,reseller_id,unit_price,discount_pct,discount_cap,units,amount_expected,amount_actual
az-2026-08-14-820,compute-pro,res-901,2.00,0.10,0.15,50,85.00,86.00``` Expected: 50*$2 = $100 less 10% = $90 but cap of 15% applies only to per-unit discount computation; due to rounding we ended up with $86 billed.

raj_partner_ops: We updated reseller discount rules in mapping table last month. Did the ingest change rounding logic?

ingestbot: Ingest pipeline log: "applied discount_cap after per-line rounding" at 2026-08-14T04:12Z. Transform version v4.2.0 deployed 2026-08-10 introduced a rounding step to 2 decimal places before cap application.

maria_sre: That ordering is wrong per the billing spec. Fix is to compute raw discounts at high precision, apply cap, then round final line amounts. Hotfix plan: revert rounding step ordering and add unit tests for cap semantics.

kevin_revenue: Financial impact estimate?

leah_fin: Preliminary: 160 affected lines across 72 invoices. Underbilled amount ~ $9,640. That will need revenue adjustment and partner notification.

sam.billing: Mitigation steps: 1) push hotfix to correct rounding order; 2) reprocess impacted export files and generate adjustment transactions; 3) notify partners and prepare revenue memos.

maria_sre: Branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/623 (fix/discount-rounding-order). Includes tests and rollout notes. Rolling to staging now.

ingestbot: Queued reprocess job rc-20260814-discount-fix by sam.billing.

raj_partner_ops: I'll message partners and ask for acceptance window for adjustments. Some may prefer we absorb underbilling for the current month vs. apply retro credits.

kevin_revenue: Finance preference is to correct and post adjustments this period; will coordinate with GAAP team on recognition. Please provide a per-invoice delta CSV.

sam.billing: Reprocess finished 2026-08-14T11:20Z: 152 lines corrected, 8 flagged for manual review due to custom caps. Generated adjustments for 70 invoices, total $9,350 (slightly less after rounding). 2 partner approvals pending.

leah_fin: Thanks team. Action items: 1) merge PR and ship the rounding fix to prod; 2) deliver per-invoice CSV to revenue ops; 3) update partner onboarding docs to state cap semantics; 4) add a Redwood Console alert if monthly underbilling > $5k. Closing loop after partner responses.
